title: Abelian hypercohomology presheaf on a ringed space
statement: Let $(X,\mathcal O_X)$ be a ringed space [def-weil-locally-ringed-space-morphism], in a common universe containing its opens and module values [def-weil-size-convention]. Let $\mathcal A=\operatorname{Mod}(\mathcal O_X)$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], $\mathcal P=\operatorname{Fun}(\operatorname{Opens}(X)^{op},\operatorname{Ab})$, and $A:\mathcal A\to\mathcal P$ the underlying abelian presheaf functor. Using K-injective resolutions [def-pur-kinjective-complex, prop-pur-kinjective-resolutions-exist], form its unbounded right derived functor $RA:D(\mathcal A)\to D(\mathcal P)$ [def-sfb-right-derived-functor, def-weil-abstract-derived-category], with the standard-size localization on the target. For each $n\in\mathbf Z$, define $\mathbb H_X^n=H^n\circ RA:D(\mathcal A)\to\mathcal P$. Thus on a K-injective representative $I$ of $E$, $\mathbb H_X^n(E)(V)=H^n(\Gamma(V,I))=H^n(R\Gamma(V,E))$ [def-pc-open-module-derived-sections]; restrictions are induced by section restriction in the same global complex $I$, and derived morphisms by maps between K-injective representatives. The source localization size is arbitrary [def-weil-size-convention]. Transport the unit of $RA$ from the homotopy category to complexes. On $M[0]$, take degree-zero cohomology of this unit and the canonical single-complex cohomology comparisons to obtain $u_M:A(M)\to\mathbb H_X^0(M[0])$. No arbitrary comparison map or representative is supplied as a parameter.
